headline: Stars’ Kyle Capobianco to miss at least a week with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Kyle Capobianco will miss at least a week with a lower-body injury. The outlet adds that Sam Steel is likely to return to the lineup on Thursday, while David Perron still isn't ready to play.

Capobianco is a depth defenseman, so the loss is small. Our numbers show him at 10.94 minutes a night over five games so far this season, with no points. His team has controlled slightly more of the chances with him on the ice at 5-on-5 (54 percent of expected goals, which measures the quality of shots), but that sample is tiny. Steel's return matters more. He plays 15.92 minutes a night, and Dallas has held 54.75 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice at 5-on-5. His one goal is below the 1.61 his chances suggest, so he looks due for better results. The Stars (7-4-1) have won with their goalies carrying them, saving 7.6 goals more than expected, while their own shooting is 4.6 goals below expectation. Steel back in the lineup helps that side of the ledger.
